requirement: R-EMISSION-001: All compiler-emitted CompiledWorkflow instances must pass structural validation.
R-EMISSION-002: WorkflowParts is untrusted; CompiledWorkflow construction must use try_from_parts.
R-FEATURE-001: test-util must not be enabled in vb_compile production dependencies.
R-EMISSION-003: LoweredParts to CompiledWorkflow transition must be guarded by try_from_parts.
R-ERROR-001: WorkflowError from try_from_parts must map to CompileError::Workflow with stable diagnostic codes.
R-BOUNDARY-001: Validation boundary between compiler lowering and runtime core must be enforced.
R-HAZARD-001: Unchecked emission in production code must be eliminated.
R-HAZARD-002: test-util feature leakage to production dependency graph must be eliminated.
R-HAZARD-003: Validation failures must surface as compile diagnostics, not runtime panics.
R-SCOPE-001: Change limited to compile_source emission site and Cargo.toml feature flag.
R-VERIFY-001: Proof seeds for structural validation coverage, feature-gate enforcement, error mapping, regression prevention, and boundary enforcement.
